'''Nagratha''' served as the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] circa [[7786 BBY]]. During the [[Waymancy Storm]] conflict of [[7811 BBY]], Nagratha's [[Nagratha's mother|mother]] had served with the [[Squill Sifters/Legends|Squill Sifters]] intercepting and decoding Waymancy communications. The Chancellor attended the [[25th anniversary of Victory in the Waymancy Storm|25th anniversary]] of victory in the Waymancy Storm and delivered a commemorative speech for the occasion.<ref name="EGTW Author's Cut" />
